description: A huge stone winged bull with a human head sits on a wheeled cart, hauled by a long line of bare-chested workers with ropes. Behind them is a terraced palace with columns and a garden of palms and cypresses, plus a tall stone arched aqueduct with water spilling from it on the right. Two lion statues flank a gate on the left, under a dusty, hazy sky. There is no visible text, frame or border, and nothing gory.
